question: What will the first reported revenues after September 2026 be for the following companies? (Tesla)

calls.reasoning: Reference: Q2 2026 revenue $28.24B on 480k deliveries / 13.5 GWh. Q3 2026 deliveries 486.5k (+1.3% QoQ, beat consensus 462k) and 13.7 GWh storage, so a bottom-up sum (auto ~20.5-21.0B, energy ~3.1-3.3B, services ~4.7-4.9B) gives ~28.3-28.9B. Published consensus is $27.57-28.11B, with some figures possibly stale relative to the delivery beat. Tesla beat revenue consensus in Q3 2025 and Q2 2026. Headwinds: cheaper mix and lower ASP, declining regulatory credits, energy pricing, production below deliveries. Market check: the harness found no Polymarket or Manifold market; I did not search Kalshi or bookmakers myself and came across none.
calls.dossier:
- Q3 2026 Tesla deliveries 486,532 (Model 3/Y 478,237; other 8,295); production ~464,391; storage deployed 13.7 GWh (Tesla IR / pulse2, 2026-10-02).
- Company-compiled delivery consensus was 461,974; the range of analyst estimates was 422k-482k (teslanorth / electrek, Sep-Oct 2026).
- Q2 2026: deliveries 480,126; total revenue $28,236M (record); automotive $20.52B; energy $3.14B (13.5 GWh); services/other $4.58B, +50% YoY (electrek / yahoo, 2026-07-22).
- Q3 2025: revenue $28,095M on 497,099 deliveries and 12.5 GWh.
- Revenue consensus for Q3 2026 varies by source: $27,571M (Hudson Labs), $27.87B (moomoo), $27.8B (wallstreet-online), $28.11B (alphastreet/coincentral). Some may predate the Oct 2 delivery beat.
- Q2 2026 automotive gross margin fell to 16.3%; Q2 energy margin was compressed by warranty and tariffs; the 17.7% gross-margin consensus says nothing about revenue.
- FSD paid users 1.48M; NA attach rate 55% (Hudson Labs). Services line growing fast.
- Downside factors: cheaper trims/mix lowering ASP, declining regulatory-credit revenue, Megapack ASP declines.
- Status quo: revenue about equal to Q2's $28.24B, with deliveries +1.3% QoQ and energy +1.5% QoQ.
- Resolves off total revenues in Tesla's Q3 2026 8-K/press release (expected Oct 21, 2026 after market close), not off consensus or later 10-Q revisions.
- Event window: Q3 2026 (Jul 1-Sep 30) reported in the first release after Sep 30, 2026; as of 2026-10-19 the quarter is 100% elapsed and the report is due in about 2 days.
- Searched for but not found: a segment-level Q3 revenue consensus, and any Kalshi or Polymarket market on Tesla revenue.

Bottom-up: auto ~$20.6B (volume gain offset by mix and lower credits), energy ~$3.15B, services ~$4.75B, total ~$28.4-28.6B. Published consensus of $27.6-28.1B is partly stale, and Tesla beat by ~$1.8B in Q2. Median $28.4B; small low-tail escape for an ASP or energy-recognition shock.
calls.reconciliation: The runs agree on every fact: Q3 deliveries 486,532, storage 13.7 GWh, Q2 revenue $28.236B with its segment split, and consensus $27.57-28.11B. The only dispute is judgment: a median of $28.3B vs $28.5B, i.e. how much to weight the possibly stale consensus against volume scaling. I added an explicit mix adjustment from the dossiers' own numbers ('other' models down ~4k QoQ at roughly 2x the ASP of 3/Y), which cancels most of the automotive volume gain. That puts bottom-up near $28.4-28.6B, and I land at $28.4B. No market exists. I did no web retrieval on this run.

disagreements.verdict: Mix shift away from S/X offsets the 3/Y volume gain; settled at $28.4B
